svg.title: Cart lifecycle
svg.desc: empty, then calculating after a package is added (cart.updated, cart.calculating), then priced when the prices arrive (cart.removed and cart.added for the packages that changed, then cart.calculated). A page that opens with a saved cart starts at calculating (cart.calculating only). Pricing that fails sends sdk.error and moves to unpriced; the next change prices again. A change sends cart.updated, then cart.calculating; while calculating, cart.updated only. Removing the last package, or clearing the cart, empties it (cart.updated, then cart.removed).
